llm_response.reason: Altify.app offers alternative investment products (crypto, private credit, commodities, stocks) and presents itself as a regulated entity in South Africa and Poland with clear FSP/VASP numbers. The website does not promise impossible returns, does not employ urgency, upfront fees, or psychological manipulation tactics common in scams, provides proper contact info, privacy policy, and risk disclosures. Payment methods of bank transfer and crypto are industry-standard. Although SSL certificate issues are present, the website overall fits the legitimate investment platform model and does not display strong scam signals.
